title: fanoutqa: Which of the main actors from the movie “The Avengers” have won Academy Awards? (29242cc91b49e88e)

chat_history.content: Which of the main actors from the movie “The Avengers” have won Academy Awards?

content.content:
The user asks: "Which of the main actors from the movie 'The Avengers' have won Academy Awards?" Need to list main actors and note which have won Oscars. Main Avengers cast: Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Mark Ruffalo, Chris Hemsworth, Scarlett Johansson, Jeremy Renner, Tom Hiddleston (though not main Avengers but in film), Samuel L. Jackson (Nick Fury). Also maybe Cobie Smulders, Clark Gregg, etc. Among these, which have won Academy Awards? As of 2025, Oscar winners among them: Robert Downey Jr. has not won Oscar (nominated). Chris Evans none. Mark Ruffalo none. Chris Hemsworth none. Scarlett Johansson none. Jeremy Renner none. Samuel L. Jackson none. Tom Hiddleston none. Cobie Smulders none. Clark Gregg none. The only Oscar winners maybe: none? Wait, maybe some have won as part of ensemble? Not. However, there is a main actor: perhaps "Samuel L. Jackson" has not won. So answer: none of the main actors have won Academy Awards. However, there is "Anthony Mackie"? He hasn't. So answer: none.

But maybe include "John Stewart"? Not.

Thus answer: None of the main cast have won Oscars, though some have been nominated (Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans? Actually Evans not nominated). Provide details.

Will answer directly.

content:
**Short answer:** None of the principal cast members of *The Avengers* (2012) have ever won an Academy Award (Oscar).

**Why that is the case**

| Actor (main Avengers cast) | Notable Oscar nominations? | Oscar win? |
|----------------------------|----------------------------|------------|
| **Robert Downey Jr.** (Tony Stark / Iron Man) | Nominated for **Best Actor** for *Chaplin* (1992) and **Best Supporting Actor** for *Tropic Thunder* (2008) | ❌ |
| **Chris Evans** (Steve Rogers / Captain America) | No Oscar nominations | ❌ |
| **Mark Ruffalo** (Bruce Banner / Hulk) | No Oscar nominations | ❌ |
| **Chris Hemsworth** (Thor) | No Oscar nominations | ❌ |
| **Scarlett Johansson** (Natasha Romanoff / Black Widow) | No Oscar nominations (though she has received a **Golden Globe** nomination for *Marriage Story*) | ❌ |
| **Jeremy Renner** (Clint Barton / Hawkeye) | No Oscar nominations (he has a **Golden Globe** nomination for *The Hurt Locker*) | ❌ |
| **Samuel L. Jackson** (Nick Fury) | No Oscar nominations (he has an **Academy Honorary Award**? – actually no; he has a **BAFTA** nomination) | ❌ |
| **Tom Hiddleston** (Loki) – major supporting role | No Oscar nominations | ❌ |
| **Cobie Smulders** (Maria Hill) | No Oscar nominations | ❌ |
| **Clark Gregg** (Phil Coulson) | No Oscar nominations | ❌ |
| **Anthony Mackie** (Sam Wilson / Falcon) | No Oscar nominations | ❌ |

**What does “main actors” mean?**  
For the purpose of this answer I’ve focused on the ensemble that is most commonly identified as the core Avengers team in the 2012 film: the seven heroes who appear throughout the movie (Iron Man, Captain America, Hulk, Thor, Black Widow, Hawkeye, and Nick Fury) plus the most visible supporting players (Loki, Maria Hill, Phil Coulson, and Sam Wilson). If you broaden the list to include every credited actor in the film, the conclusion stays the same—none have ever won an Oscar.

**Other awards**  
While none of the above have taken home an Academy Award, several have earned major honors from other bodies:

* **Robert Downey Jr.** – BAFTA nomination, multiple SAG and Critics’ Choice nods.  
* **Scarlett Johansson** – Golden Globe nomination for *Marriage Story*.  
* **Jeremy Renner** – Golden Globe nomination for *The Hurt Locker*.  
* **Samuel L. Jackson** – Received the **AFI Life Achievement Award** (2018) and a **Kennedy Center Honor** (2022).  

But as far as the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences is concerned, the Avengers’ principal cast members have not yet claimed an Oscar.
